answer: Auctions price honesty and forgery apart. Honest: 100 slots, bids lock 3 epochs, losers refunded less 2%. Forgers: the bid burns on challenge, and a 2-epoch window exposes fakes. Honest cost: a 60-unit bid, refunded when clean. Forger cost: 1,000 identities at 60 cost 60,000, and wander shows demand doubles price, so 10,000 cost over 1,000,000. A grove of honest bidders pays near nothing, while a whisper of fake demand lifts the price on itself.
